title: Prospecting Nythera V3
features:
Auto Minerals Tab:
[+] Auto Shake/Shovel automation
[+] Pan selection and auto Pan detection
[+] Position system with water/sand markers
[+] Multiple TP methods (Smooth Teleport, Pathfinding Walk, Instant Teleport)
[+] Automation modes (Legit with animations, Unlegit no animations)
[+] Configurable collect and shake delays
[+] Status shower
[+] Position markers visibility toggle

Auto Sell Tab:
[+] Merchant configuration
[+] Sell by item count or time delay
[+] Teleport and pathfinding sell modes
[+] Waypoint system for pathfinding routes
[+] Sell range indicator
[+] Works with Auto Minerals (or alone)

Auto Lock Tab:
[+] Lock items by their name
[+] Lock items by their rarity

Purchase Tab:
[+] Purchase Pans
[+] Purchase Totems
[+] Purchase Sluices
[+] Purchase Potions (bulk purchase)
[+] Purchase Shovels

Quests Tab:
[+] Start any quest
[+] Complete quests

Map Tab:
[+] Auto waypoint discovery
[+] Teleport to any waypoint
[+] Open teleport menu

Misc Tab:
[+] Custom walkspeed with multiplier
[+] Solar Flare ESP
[+] Traveling Merchant ESP
[+] Claim all collection index rewards

Config Tab:
[+] Config save/load system
